item.title: Welcome to nuno
item.description:
nuno is a Hugo theme for people who write. It has one typeface, four palettes, a single accent colour, and no third-party requests at all. The home page you arrived on is the whole design argument: a masthead that types itself, a column of numbered cards, and nothing else competing for attention.

What you get

The parts worth knowing about, in rough order of how often you will touch them:

item.title: Four Palettes, One Accent
item.description:
The theme has two colour switches and they are independent of each other. That is the only unusual thing about its palette system, and it is worth five minutes of explanation because almost every customisation question turns out to be about it.

The two switches
